description: A bearded man in a felt cap and layered tunic rides a grey horse at the front of a charge, pointing forward. Behind him, mounted archers in dark hoods draw bows against a background of fire and smoke. To the right, helmeted foot soldiers run toward a walled town with stone towers and a columned classical gateway under a dark, stormy sky. A small faint mark sits in the bottom-right corner. The painting fills the frame edge to edge.
